name: Chase Sinclair
headline: Data Scientist | GenAI Strategy | Analytics Transformation
summary: Data Scientist with 4+ years of experience building analytics and AI-enabled systems across federal and enterprise environments. Leads KPI design, data pipelines, dashboards, and applied AI use cases for large-scale public-facing platforms, pairing strong technical execution with a consulting mindset that turns complex data into practical decision support.

experience.title: Lead Data Scientist
experience.description: Metrics Lead for DisasterAssistance.gov, a mission-critical federal platform serving up to 20M annual users and up to 80M annual site visits.
impact_bullets: Defined KPI frameworks for 100+ daily measurement fields and automated ingestion pipelines to support real-time executive visibility during emergency response windows.
Deployed a production-grade RAG chatbot trained on complex website metrics, shifting requests to a self-service workflow and reducing manual response overhead.
Directed a migration from Excel-based grant tracking to an AWS and Snowflake pipeline that compressed a multi-hour manual process into a minutes-long workflow.
Built 20+ real-time Tableau dashboards for the DOL Office of Apprenticeship and led recurring strategy sessions with leadership to support program decisions.

experience.title: Data Scientist Intern
experience.description: Developed NLP and clustering solutions to improve semantic search across large document corpora.
impact_bullets: Built automated topic-detection workflows for unstructured text.
Optimized machine learning clustering models to improve search relevance across enterprise documents.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computational Modeling & Data Analytics

projects.name: Career Intelligence Agent
projects.summary: Built a recruiter-facing AI application that answers questions about a candidate using grounded retrieval, visible source evidence, and live LLM-as-judge evaluation.
impact_bullets: Combined a FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend into a portfolio-ready recruiter research experience.
Implemented LangGraph workflows for ingestion, profile synthesis, recruiter Q&A, and evaluation.
Exposed evidence snippets and quality metrics directly in the UI to make retrieval quality transparent.

projects.name: SignalPulse AI
projects.summary: Built a B2B sales intelligence platform that monitors hiring signals, enriches them with AI, and surfaces high-intent buying windows through a production-grade dashboard.
impact_bullets: Automated daily ingestion and enrichment of job-posting signals to identify software buying intent.
Designed a full-stack analytics workflow spanning orchestration, storage, enrichment, and dashboard delivery.
Kept the MVP ingestion budget on the free tier by constraining queries and filtering before AI processing.

projects.name: OSS Dependency Risk Agent
projects.summary: Built an end-to-end AI engineering system that monitors open-source projects for health deterioration and generates structured dependency-risk recommendations.
impact_bullets: Modeled health scores across 200 OSS projects using multi-layer data pipelines and six repository health signals.
Designed a five-node LangGraph agent that investigates deteriorating dependencies and recommends replace, upgrade, or monitor actions.
Connected lakehouse processing, agent orchestration, and a dashboard into a single portfolio-ready AI system.

projects.name: AI Use Case Evaluation & Prioritization Tool
projects.summary: Developed an internal AI-enabled framework to evaluate and prioritize use cases across personas using structured inputs, scoring logic, and generative AI support.
impact_bullets: Created a repeatable framework for comparing AI investment opportunities.
Combined structured evaluation criteria with AI-assisted reasoning to support data-informed prioritization.

projects.name: Generative AI Consumer Recall Detection

impact_bullets: Designed a multimodal workflow that translates photos of product labels into recall lookups.
Used AI-generated grounded explanations to make recall results easier for users to understand.
